notes.title: UPDATE 2 MAZA
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672760/Maza/

NEW UPDATE!

For those who are launching for the first time - I remind you - [b]JUST LEAVE THE GAME AND LOG IN AGAIN![/b]

In this update:

[list]
[*] Minor bugs have been fixed
[*] New quest: Find 5 books - each will give 1000 points and will appear on the shelf at home!
[*] New skins: including old ones, you can now simply change skins and open new ones!
[*] New location: When you reach the maximum points - the last location with an interesting item will open! ːlaughing_yetiː
[/list]

That's all!

notes.title: UPDATE MAZA
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672760/Maza/

I REPEAT: WHEN YOU LAUNCH FOR THE FIRST TIME - EXIT THE GAME AND ENTER IT AGAIN (the resolution is adapted to the monitor)

In this update:

[list]
[*] Bugs fixed
[*] New way to earn points
[*] New locations and characters added
[/list]

If someone found it too hard to earn points in Shooting Range or Arm Wrestling, now there is a new way: "Color Battle"! Here you can score a large number of points much faster, but the punishment for mistakes is also a little harsher.

That is, at the moment new content has been added for achieving points:

(in addition to achieving 2000 points)

5000 - New skin and new location "KVA-KVA"

10000 - New skin, final title and new location (near the house)

15000 - New character (the one who does not like the number 3)

That's all! If you find bugs or glitches - write!

notes.title: FLASH PLAYER NO NEED NO MORE
notes.content:
I remade the game using the Zinc compiler! Which, unfortunately, could not find anything other than the trial version! But the functions that are there are enough! Moreover, to my surprise, Steam functions started working (overlay, screenshots, etc.)

But I don’t recommend opening the Overlay - for some reason it slows down, freezes and has difficulty getting back into the game!

However, now Flash Player is not required - the game will open on any PC!

UPD: The latest version was downloaded via SteamGUI - and still for some reason the overlay only works in live locations with brakes! It freezes on the map, menu and other small ones! Therefore, you can use the background functions of Steam (screenshot, etc.), but it’s better not open it!

notes.title: v 2.0 (Motomaniac)
notes.content:
Back in 2009, I made one mini game [b]"MOTOFIGHTER"[/b]! I managed to decompile it and insert part of the internals into [b]VIRA[/b]

There is a slot machine at the new location and you can make a race!

[list]
[*] Small bugs fixed
[*] Added a mini-shooter (avialable only in Russian version)
[*] Added subtitles for last 3 locations!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
In this update:

[list]
[*] Bugs fixed
[*] Added 3 new REAL locations of Yekaterinburg for the "Walk" mode, which, after completing the story (who has already passed, can simply enter the code in the download)
[/list]

Actually, that's all, locations are added so that there is just a little something to do after the plot. A lot of time and they won't take, but it's done along with fixing bugs. When they let me add cards, in honor of this I will add one more location after the plot!

notes.title: RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]VIRA[/b] is a small 2D quest made according to the principle of Action Script 2.0. Hence immediately a warning - YOU BETTER INSTALL ADOBE FLASH PLAYER, starting from the 10th version!!! I thought it was an independent EXE, but when checking it on other computers, it still requires ːsteammockingː for some reason

The Steam API is not tied to the game - no matter how much one answer tried everywhere - either rebuild the game again in another language, or just rebuild it and only then) Do not insert it into the finished project)) If there are specialists who know how to do this - write in the comments ... ːsteamthumbsupː

As soon as Steam gives you the opportunity - Trading cards will be added! ːsteamthisː

Well, briefly about the game: This project has been gathering dust in folders since 2010)))) From here I think you understand why the maximum I could move events forward was only 2015 - I was too lazy to redo everything all over again.

BUT!

If you take this idea and the format of the game well, then by 2025 I will try to make another game in THE SAME UNIVERSE! It won't be VIRA 2, it will be a different game about a different hero with his plot, but in the same universe (the characters are the same). I will try to do it on AS3, so I can connect with the Steam API. There is no exact plot, but I know that the events will take place in modern times. Moscow city. The principle of the Quest will be the same (three slots inverter, point and click), but I will be able to add episodes of a first-person shooter (I made such games on as2, and here I will pack everything into one project) Naturally, depending on the feedback and wishes, I can change the vector development of the future game.

Well, or if no one likes it, then it will not exist AT ALL! ːsteammockingː

Play! I'll lower the price as soon as I can! For now, this is the minimum ceiling for Steam)
